title: Pure Aroma
summary: Aroma cards only, with generic Plant Extra Deck monsters and staples; the page's Sunavalon starter is left out. Aroma monsters switch on while your LP are higher than your opponent's, and each one triggers whenever you gain LP. Aroma Garden, Aroma Gardening and the Winds Continuous Traps gain LP every turn, so the triggers keep firing. The 2024 cards lead. Aromalilith Rosalina summons a non-Tuner Aroma from the Deck, and Aroma Blend places a Winds Trap from the Deck and later Fusion Summons from the GY. Aromalilith Rosemary searches an Aroma card and summons up to three from the hand each time you gain LP. Aromalilith Magnolia banishes one card for each Winds Trap you control. Rosalina locks you into Plant monsters for the turn, so the Extra Deck is mostly Plant.
main: Aromalilith Rosalina

Aromage Jasmine
Extra Normal Summon of a Plant; draws when you gain LP.
Aromage Laurel

Tuner: discards on either turn to gain LP; revives itself.
Aromage Rosemary
Stops monster effects when a Plant attacks; changes a position on LP gain.
Aromage Cananga
Shrinks their monsters; bounces a Spell/Trap on LP gain.
Aromage Bergamot
Piercing damage; gains 1000 ATK on LP gain.

Aroma Gardening
